context.why: Merge-gate change to FS-030, asked for by the maintainer after the walkthrough: 'all coordinate input MUST be declared in WGS84. The onus for now is on the person inputting data to make a conversion if necessary.' Accepting other coordinate reference systems is now enhancement issue #512. The feature is otherwise complete, reviewed and green. Simplify the location input in fairdm/contrib/location/forms.py and its template fairdm/contrib/location/templates/location/widgets/location.html so that a location is always typed as a latitude and a longitude in WGS 84 (any of the three notations, via parse_coordinate), plus optional elevation and uncertainty on the full input. Remove: the reference-system subwidget and its EPSG box, SUGGESTED_SYSTEMS, get_systems, the json_script systems list, the script's geographic/Northing/Easting switching, the projected branch of read_point and the magnitude (1e9) and converted-range checks that only guarded conversion, any CoordTransform/SpatialReference use. Keep: parse_coordinate and its checks, the 64-character cap, the elevation/uncertainty rules, the 'Reads as' hint, the data-attribute escaping (if the srid attribute goes, no user text may enter a JS string), the approved layout otherwise. The point-only (full=False) and full inputs may now differ only by elevation and uncertainty; collapse anything that becomes redundant (smallest change, orthodox Django). Delete the tests that only served other systems; keep every other assertion. Update: spec.md (FR-007, User Story 1 text and AS 1.3, Clarifications, Edge Cases line on projected systems, SC-001, Key Entities 'Reference system', Boundary gains a line pointing at #512), decisions.md D6 (record the change, with a new D29 entry 'Coordinates are entered in WGS 84 only' with an **ADR:** verdict line), sketch.md 'What was ruled by eye' (record the maintainer's change), plan.md D3, research.md conversion row, docs/portal-development/locations.md, CONTEXT.md (Reference system term), CHANGELOG.md entry, ADR 0032 if it mentions conversion. Tabular import already takes WGS 84 only; check its docs say so.
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.
Remedies are the smallest edit that fixes the named failure; add no mechanism beyond what the task says.
Out of this cycle (do not do): TST-002 declare_addressing, TST-003, TST-004, COR-005 — they are carried to the maintainer.
